commissioner.name: Greg Sankey
commissioner.note: Former SEC executive associate commissioner/COO and ex-Southland Conference commissioner; succeeded Mike Slive. Contract terms not public; no 2025-26 change found.

governance.notes: Texas/Oklahoma admitted unanimously (July 2021) under the 3/4 rule (11 of 14 then). Bylaw-amendment and removal thresholds not public.

exitTerms.feeDescription: No published withdrawal fee. Practical exit cost = forfeited distributions plus breaking the grant of rights that runs with the ESPN/ABC deal.

grantOfRights.description: Members' media rights pooled for the life of the ESPN/ABC agreement (2024-25 through 2033-34).

exitTerms.notes: No SEC member has tried to leave since the league formed; exit is modeled as near-impossible.

distribution.notes: Reported ~$52.5M to each of the 14 legacy members; Oklahoma and Texas phased in at ~$27.5M in year one. Not re-verified this session; distributions.json (money agent) is authoritative.

football.format: 16 teams, no divisions; 3 annual opponents + 6 rotating (every team plays every other at least once every 2 years); top two meet in SEC Championship; each team must also play 1 non-conference Power 4 opponent (ACC, Big Ten, Big 12 or Notre Dame). Annual opponents reviewed every 4 years (2026-29 cycle). 2026 is the first nine-game season.
football.protectedRivalriesNote: 2026-29 annual opponents (24 pairings). Alabama, Arkansas, Auburn and Florida sets verified via search; the remaining pairings are reconstructed from memory of the Sept 2025 release and are low confidence.

mediaDays.dates2026: mid-July 2026 (site rotates Atlanta/Nashville/Dallas; 2026 site and dates not verified)

commissioner.name: Tony Petitti
commissioner.note: Ex-CBS Sports exec, MLB Network president, MLB deputy commissioner, Activision Blizzard Esports. Council of Presidents/Chancellors unanimously approved a 5-year extension through June 2033 (announced 2026-08-26); terms undisclosed. Will negotiate the next media deal (current ~$7B deal expires 2030).

governance.notes: USC/UCLA (2022) and Oregon/Washington (2023) were approved unanimously. 2025 'Big Ten Enterprises' private-capital plan (UC Investments, GOR extension to ~2046) stalled after Michigan/USC objections; status in late 2026 not verified.

exitTerms.feeDescription: No published withdrawal fee. Exit cost = forfeited distributions plus grant of rights tied to media deals (Fox/CBS/NBC through 2029-30).

grantOfRights.description: Media rights pooled for the term of the Fox/CBS/NBC deals (2023-24 through 2029-30); exact GOR end date not public.

exitTerms.notes: Maryland (2014) and Rutgers took reduced/advanced shares on entry; that phase-in is now over.

distribution.notes: First year of the new media deal; reported ~$60.5M per full-share school on ~$929M conference revenue. USC/UCLA/Oregon/Washington entered on reduced shares. Not re-verified this session.

football.protectedRivalriesNote: From memory of the 2024-28 Flex Protect list; low confidence.

mbbTournament.note: Rotates Indianapolis/Chicago (United Center); 2027 site not verified.

mediaDays.dates2026: late July 2026 (2025 edition was Las Vegas; 2026 site/dates not verified)

commissioner.name: Brett Yormark
commissioner.note: Ex-NASCAR VP, Brooklyn Nets/BSE CEO, Roc Nation COO. Had a 3-year extension (May 2025) through 2030, but on 2026-10-30 announced he will step down effective 2027-01-31 to become CEO of a RedBird Capital sports/venue company in Milan (AC Milan parent group). Board of Directors (chair: Kansas chancellor Douglas Girod) is running a national search; no successor named as of 2026-11-25. Speculated candidates include American commissioner Tim Pernetti; a rumor linking Texas Tech booster Cody Campbell was denied by Campbell.

members2026.affiliatesNote: Affiliate list from memory (2024-25); low confidence.

governance.notes: 2021 expansion (BYU, Cincinnati, Houston, UCF) needed 8 of 10 votes. Board chair 2026-27: Douglas Girod (Kansas). Big 12 courted/considered Memphis at some point (AP: Pernetti commented on Memphis' 'attempted move to Big 12'); details not verified.

exitTerms.feeDescription: Bylaws (as reported during the 2021-23 Texas/Oklahoma exit): a member leaving before the grant of rights expires forfeits roughly two years of distributions and must give ~18 months' notice. Texas/OU negotiated early release for ~$100M in foregone distributions.

grantOfRights.description: Members' rights granted through the ESPN/Fox deals running 2025-26 through 2030-31.

exitTerms.notes: Big 12 sold the 2022 renewal early, 6 years/$2.28B. Colorado received a $2.5M transition bonus on rejoining (2024).

distribution.notes: Reported record ~$470M total; full share ~$39.8M (Texas/OU received full share in their final year); 2023 newcomers on partial shares. Not re-verified this session.

football.protectedRivalriesNote: No formal protected list confirmed; these rivalries were preserved in the 2024-27 rotation (low confidence).

mediaDays.dates2026: July 2026 (The Star in Frisco hosted 2025; 2026 not verified)

commissioner.name: Jim Phillips
commissioner.note: Ex-Northwestern AD. 2023 three-year extension keeps him into 2029 (signed amid Big Ten interest). No 2026 extension found. On NCAA Board of Governors. Says he expects 'four or five years' of ACC stability post-settlement; in May 2026 backed the Big Ten's 24-team CFP push.

governance.notes: SMU/Cal/Stanford admitted Sept 2023 by 12-3 vote (Clemson, FSU, UNC no; NC State flipped). Bylaw-amendment threshold low confidence.

exitTerms.feeDescription: Under the March 4, 2025 settlement with Florida State and Clemson: exit fee $165M in FY2026, falling $18M per year to $75M from FY2031 through FY2036. A school that pays the fee leaves with its own media rights (the grant of rights no longer binds it). Before: 3x annual operating budget (~$130M+) plus GOR damages (FSU estimated total cost >$572M).

grantOfRights.description: Grant of rights runs to June 30, 2036, matching the ESPN deal (ESPN exercised its option to extend through 2035-36). Paying the exit fee releases the leaving school's rights.

exitTerms.notes: Fiscal year = July-June (FY2027 = 2026-27). Notice deadline reportedly moved by the settlement to June 1 of the year before departure (from Aug 15); single-source, low confidence. Fee schedule widely reported (On3, Sportskeeda, CBS) and matches the brief.

distribution.notes: From FY2026 the settlement's 'brand initiative' applies: 40% of TV revenue split equally among the 14 longstanding members, 60% by a 5-year rolling TV-viewership ranking (favors Clemson, FSU, UNC, Miami). Separate 'success initiatives' performance pool. SMU takes no media-rights share for 9 years; Cal/Stanford started at 30% shares rising to full by year 10. Per-school dollar amounts not verified (~$40-45M range pre-tiering).

football.format: 17 football teams, no divisions. AD vote (Sept 2025): 9 conference games + at least 10 Power 4 games a year starting 2026. Most teams play 9 ACC games in 2026; some play 8 because of existing non-conference contracts; 16 of 17 play 9 in 2027, with one team at 8 + two P4 non-conference games (odd-number fix). Top two meet in ACC Championship. Notre Dame plays ~5 ACC opponents a year.
football.protectedRivalriesNote: Exact structure of the nine-game model not verified; these traditional rivalries are assumed annual (low confidence).

mediaDays.dates2026: July 2026 (ACC Football Kickoff; Charlotte hosted 2024-25; 2026 not verified)

commissioner.name: Teresa Gould
commissioner.note: Former Pac-12 deputy commissioner and ex-WCC associate commissioner; first woman to lead an autonomy conference. Board extended her contract 5 years through the 2030-31 season (June 15-16, 2026). Testified to Senate Commerce Committee June 3, 2026.

governance.notes: OSU and WSU ran the conference as a two-member board from Dec 2023 (Washington Supreme Court let stand the injunction) until the relaunch on July 1, 2026, when seven new full members joined. New bylaw thresholds not public. Exactly 8 football members = NCAA FBS minimum, so one defection would endanger FBS status.

exitTerms.feeDescription: New-member withdrawal terms not publicly disclosed.

grantOfRights.description: Rebuilt-Pac-12 media package (CBS as primary partner) reportedly runs ~2026-27 through 2030-31; GOR terms not verified.

exitTerms.notes: The conference owed the Mountain West a scheduling-agreement 'poaching penalty' (up to $55M claimed); settled Aug 4, 2026 (OSU/WSU ~$10M each; see legal-exit-fees-gor.md).

distribution.notes: FY2027 is the first year of the rebuilt league; per-school figures not verified. OSU/WSU held legacy assets (CFP/NCAA units, ~$65M from departing schools) in 2024-26.

football.format: 8 football members, full round robin (7 games) assumed; top two meet in the Pac-12 Championship.
football.protectedRivalriesNote: Round robin makes protection moot; listed pairs are marquee rivalries.

championshipGame.note: 2026 site not verified (likely higher seed's campus or a neutral site).

football.notes: The 2024-25 Pac-12/Mountain West scheduling agreement for OSU/WSU has expired.

commissioner.name: Gloria Nevarez
commissioner.note: Attorney; former WCC commissioner (2018-22) and ex-Pac-12 senior associate commissioner; succeeded Craig Thompson. Board extended her 4 years through Dec 31, 2030 (announced Dec 2025).

members2026.notes: ABQ Journal counts 14 schools for 2026-27; 13 identified here. Hawaii became a full member July 1, 2026 (was football-only) but keeps beach volleyball, men's volleyball, water polo and men's swimming in the Big West. UC Davis football stays in the Big Sky. Grand Canyon (no football) joined July 1, 2025. Five schools (Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State, San Diego State, Utah State) left for the Pac-12 on July 1, 2026. 10 football teams in 2026.

governance.notes: Board chair at the Nevarez extension: Ed Seidel (Wyoming president). UNLV signed a membership extension in 2024 with incentives. NDSU (FCS power) is in its FBS transition: ineligible for the MW title game, CFP and bowls for two years unless the NCAA grants its waiver petition (status not verified).

exitTerms.feeDescription: Bylaw exit fee of about 2x annual distribution with timely notice (~$17-19M per school in the 2024 Pac-12 departures); larger for late notice (Utah State billed ~$38M). Departing schools' claims were settled in Aug 2026 for $49M total ($9.8M each withheld from final distributions).
exitTerms.notes: Entry fees: NDSU $12.5M (football-only), NIU $2M (football-only). Media: CW deal through 2031 (see media_deals.json).

distribution.notes: Settlement proceeds (~$69-70M combined from the departing schools plus the Pac-12 side) go to remaining members, e.g. UNM ~$5.6M. Regular per-school share not verified.

football.format: 10 football teams, no divisions; top two meet in the MW Championship at the higher seed's stadium.
football.protectedRivalriesNote: Schedule model for 2026 not verified (low confidence).

name: American Conference
foundedNote: Legal successor to the 1979 Big East charter; became the American Athletic Conference in 2013; renamed 'American Conference' in 2025.

commissioner.name: Tim Pernetti
commissioner.note: Former Rutgers AD (2009-13, resigned over the Mike Rice scandal) and ex-CBS College Sports Network exec; succeeded Mike Aresco. Led the 2025 rebrand. Named in speculation for the open Big 12 job (Oct-Nov 2026); interviewed for it in 2022.

members2026.notes: 14 football members in 2026. A July 2026 Bay News 9 piece said '15 in football'; likely a miscount (no 15th school found).

pendingChanges.notes: JMU board voted unanimously Oct 12, 2026 to join 'no later than July 1, 2028'; AP/Fox (Nov 19, 2026) report the move was moved up to 2027. Entry fee $23M; Sun Belt exit fee ~$5M, both privately raised; JMU moved fast because the Sun Belt was about to vote on higher exit fees.

governance.notes: Pernetti publicly open to further expansion; courted Air Force (2024). Pac-12 courted Memphis (and others) in 2025.

exitTerms.feeDescription: Historical bylaw: $10M withdrawal fee plus 27 months' notice; early releases negotiated higher (UConn $17M, 2020; Cincinnati/Houston/UCF $18M each to leave in 2023). Current fee may have been raised (not verified).

grantOfRights.description: ESPN deal through 2031-32; GOR not confirmed.

exitTerms.notes: Army and Navy are football-only; their annual game is non-conference.

distribution.notes: ESPN deal (~$1B over 12 years, 2020-32) is the base; per-school figures not verified.
